cases.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (N-TAF1 reduction in iPSC-NSCs)
cases.mechanism_detail: Patient fibroblasts carrying the 2.6-kb intron 32 SVA showed reduced TAF1 transcript fragments from exons 32-36 spanning the insertion, and iPSC-derived neural stem cells showed ~3-fold lower N-TAF1 (exon 34') expression than controls.
cases.quote: Compared with control cells, XDP fibroblasts exhibited decreased expression of TAF1 transcript fragments derived from exons 32-36, a region spanning the SVA insertion site.
